doc.description: Benchmark of ARM CMSIS-DSP against the equivalent Paparazzi code, run on the autopilot itself (CPU cycles counted with the Cortex-M DWT counter): matrix product and inverse (3x3, 6x6, 12x12), 2nd order low-pass filter over 64 samples, PID over 64 steps. The benchmark runs once, a few seconds after boot (it blocks the main loop for a fraction of a second: do not use it on a vehicle that is moving), then the results are sent every 2 s in a PAYLOAD_FLOAT message: [0] CPU clock (MHz), then 3 values per test: Paparazzi cycles, CMSIS cycles, max abs difference of the results (-1 when the two algorithms are not the same). Tests: mat_mult 3, 6, 12 | mat_inv 3, 6, 12 | lowpass x64 | PID x64 (Paparazzi update_pid_f) | PID x64 (same formula as CMSIS, plain C) Read them with sw/tools/cmsis_bench_report.py or in the Messages tool.
